questions.q: Which best describes a symphonic poem?
options: A one-movement orchestral work that tells a story or paints a scene
A piece for solo piano in three movements
A song for solo voice with piano
questions.why: Symphonic poems are single-movement programme works for orchestra.

questions.q: Smetana's Vltava is an example of musical...
questions.why: It celebrates a Czech river and uses folk-style dance, a feature of nationalism.

options: A scale used in every key
A short recurring theme linked to a character or idea
questions.why: A leitmotif is a recurring idea tied to a person, object or idea, as in Star Wars.

questions.q: Describe how Smetana uses the orchestra to suggest the two sources of the river. [2]
questions.model: Flutes (and clarinets) play light, rippling quavers over plucked pizzicato strings, in a quiet, delicate texture, which sounds like small streams.
